text:
maria: heads up — putting a quick proposal on the table: a `delayed-scrub` mode for request/response logs. idea is to capture an unredacted snapshot for a short TTL (e.g., 30–120m) accessible only to an audited oncall cohort, then auto-scrub. would help debugging hard errors without permanently storing PII.
aj: curious — how would access be gated? we can't open a long window for everyone.
maria: gated by role + ephemeral tokens. only allowed when a route is in `inspect` or during a canary window. every access emits an audit event and requires justification string.
sasha: legal flags: some regions require immediate redaction for certain data classes. we need per-tenant policy overrides and an allowlist denylist mapping. if tenant opts out, scrub immediately.
devon: implementation sketch — server-side sampler decides capture, stores encrypted blob in ephemeral s3 with TTL, key in KMS that is rotated and only accessible via k/v lease to `sre_oncall` role. proto config:
```yaml
request_logging:
  mode: delayed-scrub
  retention_seconds: 3600   # default 1h
  max_expose_seconds: 7200  # cap
  inspect_roles: ["sre_oncall", "platform_lead"]
  require_justification: true
  tenant_override: true
```
kat: Console UX notes — show a per-route small warning badge "ephemeral unmasked logs" and a two-step enable: (1) enable inspect on route, (2) pick TTL. also show live audit trail in side panel with quick-revoke button.
jamal: sampling interaction: if we have 1% sampling, do we still capture full unmasked for sampled requests only? or capture metadata for all and unmask only on sampled? prefer capture metadata + hashed fingerprint for majority, full blob only if sampled+oncall requested.
devon: prefer hashed fingerprints + prefix cache. full blob creation is heavier (storage + encryption). plan: create blob only when request selected by sampler AND route inspect flag true. else store only redact-safe summary.
aj: question re: regressions — how do we keep latency spikes from this? encryption + s3 upload on request path smells bad.
maria: agreed — do async upload from worker queue. keep sync path to write a small reference and fingerprint. queue has priority with backpressure to avoid blocking user requests.
sasha: add: auto-scrub should be verifiable. include a daily proof-of-scrub job that emits scrubbing hashes to audit log (immutable). legal likes receipts.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout for `delayed-scrub` feature starts 2026-04-02T18:00Z to infra-canary-1 cluster.
kat: small UX ask — in Console, make the justification field required and searchable in the audit view. ops will want to filter by justification tag.
jamal: also add quota/charge implications. storing ephemeral blobs counts against tenant storage budget; show estimated cost on route toggle.
maria: summary: agreement on concept with constraints: per-tenant opt-out, role-based access, async blob creation, daily proof-of-scrub. next steps: write short RFC + spike for queueing + console mockups. volunteers: devon + kat for spike, aj for oncall gating, sasha to loop legal. I'll file RFC by EOD.
aj: happy to pair on gating logic tomorrow.
sasha: will draft legal constraints and a short tenant-policy matrix.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
